facts.fact: The Office Togolais des Recettes reports electronic payment (telepaiement) of VAT at 100% for the DGE and DME directorates in 2025 and 24% for the DCIG/DOFAN/DOFR directorates.
OTR publishes electronic declaration and payment rates by directorate for 2020 to 2025, with telepaiement at 24% for DCIG/DOFAN/DOFR in 2025, up from 13% in 2024.
